title: multisim-build circuit IR
description: Intermediate representation between a circuit screenshot and a Multisim artifact. One component per pin-net mapping. This is the only thing the user must confirm before anything is rendered.

title.description: printable name, goes into the netlist header

nodes.description: optional allow-list of net names; when present every pin net must appear here. Ground is always "0".

ref.description: designator, e.g. R1, V1, Q2; must be unique

type.description: R/C/L/V/I are two-terminal; D is anode,cathode; Q is c,b,e; X is a subcircuit call

value.description: SPICE value text: 10k, 100n, DC 5, AC 1, SIN(0 1 1k). For D/Q/X this is the model or subcircuit name. Unknown values stay in the IR as "?" and block rendering.

pins.description: pin number as string -> net name. Numbers follow SPICE order per type. Net "0" is ground.

confirmed.description: false when the screenshot was ambiguous; a false value blocks rendering until the user answers

note.description: why this part was read this way, for the confirmation table

spice.description: escape hatch: full statement text after the ref, bypasses the template
